charts.title: Requests per minute
charts.query: select count(*) as Count from stream group by time(1m)

charts.title: Errors
charts.query: select count(*) as Errors from stream where @Level = 'Error' group by time(1m)

charts.title: Boards Activity
charts.query: select @Timestamp, @Message, UserId, BoardId from stream where @Message like '%Board%'

charts.title: Tasks Activity
charts.query: select @Timestamp, @Message, UserId, BoardId, TaskId from stream where @Message like '%Task%'

charts.title: Database Operations
charts.query: select @Timestamp, @Message, UserId, BoardId, TaskId from stream where @Message like 'DB:%'
